entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling because I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?

It's more about the fit. I've taken them on a couple of rides, and no matter how I position the cleats, they're just not comfortable. I'm starting to get some nasty blisters, and I don't think they're the right model for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not what we want. Comfort is key. Can you tell me when you received the order?
Let's see... it was delivered about 20 days ago.
Okay, thank you for that. One moment while I pull up our return policy for you.
Alright, I've checked for you. The good news is that you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return and get you a full refund.
Oh, wonderful. That's a relief. I appreciate you making that easy.

Of course. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed.

That's great, thank you. Now, since I did have to go through the trouble of testing them out and dealing with the discomfort, and now have to repackage them, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase? I was already looking at a different pair.

I can definitely understand why you'd ask. However, our policy only allows for the full refund on the returned item. I'm not able to generate a goodwill credit or discount for a return based on fit or preference.
Alright, I figured it was worth a shot. The full refund is fair enough. I've received the email with the label. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. We'll get that refund processed for you as soon as the shoes arrive. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
